name: The Contemporary Austin — Jones Center
hours_summary: Wed–Sun · 11 AM – 6 PM (Thu until 8 PM) · closed Mon–Tue
tagline: Austin's contemporary art museum — downtown gallery, plus a lakeside sculpture park at Laguna Gloria.
description: Austin's contemporary art museum, with two sites: the Jones Center on Congress Avenue (changing exhibitions in a downtown gallery with a Jim Hodges roofline piece visible from the street) and Laguna Gloria — a lakefront sculpture park at an Italianate villa, 15 minutes west by car.

tips.text: Jones Center admission includes Laguna Gloria's grounds on the same day — worth both if the weather is good.
Free admission every Tuesday (when open) and Thursday evenings.

highlights.item: With Liberty and Justice for All… For All, Jim Hodges, 2014
Charles Umlauf and Teresita Fernández sculptures along the lake

distance_landmark: Downtown, 3 blocks south of Texas Capitol
